# BlockSuite 0.27 runtime

- Upstream: https://github.com/toeverything/AFFiNE
- Revision: `42322d13fe2063fc0891f986110900a40ac1de29`
- Version: `0.27.0`
- License: MIT

`blocksuite-affine-0.27.0-geocrm.1.tgz` is an offline npm package containing the
official compiled BlockSuite package closure used by Folio. GeoCRM adds file-scope
metadata required by Vanilla Extract and two missing facade exports. The expanded
package tree is intentionally not stored in the repository.
